## Foods & dishes
- [[World Wide Dishes]]: 1 dish (*papeda*, sago porridge, shared with Indonesia), with an ingredient list. No other food dataset labels PNG.

## Compounds & traditional medicine
- [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]]: 78 records (44 taxa). [[NPASS]]: 61 species–compound pairs. [[CMAUP]]: 54 plants. [[KNApSAcK Family]]: flag page. [[FooDB]] has sago palm, taro and sweet potato; global backbone via [[Global]].

## Gaps
- Highly diverse staple-based diets (sago, sweet potato, taro) with no dish, recipe or composition coverage.
